subject: WDD
name: Web Fundamentals
description: This course introduces students to the World Wide Web and to careers in web site design and development. The course is hands on with students actually participating in simple web designs and programming. It is anticipated that students who complete this course will understand the fields of web design and development and will have a good idea if they want to pursue this degree as a major.

subject: WDD
name: Dynamic Web Fundamentals
description: This course builds on web fundamentals by adding JavaScript to HTML and CSS pages. Students learn responsive design, the DOM, functions, objects, forms and local storage while creating interactive, dynamic web pages.

subject: WDD
name: Web Frontend Development I
description: The earlier version of Web Frontend Development I. Students build responsive, accessible front-end websites with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, practicing good design, testing and deployment habits.

subject: WDD
name: Web Frontend Development I
description: Students deepen their front-end skills with accessibility, performance and modern JavaScript: ES modules, asynchronous code, and fetching and displaying JSON from APIs. They also work with CSS animations, modals and form design, and finish with a multi-page website project.

subject: WDD
name: Web Frontend Development II
description: Students work in teams on a larger front-end application, practicing a professional workflow, JavaScript development, project planning and a final development report.

subject: WDD
name: Web Full-Stack Development
description: Students bring the full web stack together by developing and deploying a full-stack web application with React, Next.js and TypeScript, using modern development workflows and cloud deployment while working as a productive team.

subject: CSE
name: Introduction to Programming
description: An introduction to programming concepts using Python: input and output, variables and expressions, decisions, loops, lists, files and functions.

subject: CSE
name: Programming with Functions
description: Students strengthen their Python skills by writing, testing and fixing functions, and by working with lists, dictionaries, text files, exceptions and objects, finishing with a programming project.

subject: CSE
name: Programming with Classes
description: Students learn object-oriented programming in C#: abstraction, encapsulation, inheritance and polymorphism, using classes to build well-structured programs.

subject: CSE
name: Programming with Data Structures
description: Students learn core data structures and algorithms in C#: dynamic arrays, stacks, queues, sets, maps, linked lists, recursion and trees, along with performance analysis and testing.

subject: CSE
name: Software Testing
description: An introduction to software testing concepts, processes and tools. Students write requirements and test cases, build and run effective tests, practice full-system and non-functional testing, and prepare a test plan, with hands-on automation in Python.

subject: CSE
name: Web Backend Development
description: Students build data-driven, server-side rendered web applications with Node.js and Express, using EJS templates, SQL databases, the MVC pattern, data validation and deployment.

subject: CSE
name: Web Services
Technology: Node.js, Express, MongoDB, REST, OAuth, Swagger
description: Students design, document, secure and test web services: RESTful APIs built with Node.js, Express and MongoDB, documented with Swagger, protected with OAuth, and deployed to the cloud.
